detail: Red on hbox batch 3 (bdd4f40c4), lat1 batch 4 (55ff708a6) and fill-peer2 (bdd4f40c4). Named natives on set 3a9806784 (bq10050400-0135): peer_catchup OK 5 ran (was 4/4 at node.start); peering 23/24 with full_store passing (the one error is test_transit_hygiene_refused_offer_memory_and_relay_checks, a different seam); peer_pull trickling green on prlane3. The e2e-tier cases of the 10-04 note (test_native_install upgrade walk, hybrid_author) share the start path and ride the same image batch.
